rationale: The draft's claims about Update 1.9.51 adjusting space combat difficulty (chunk 5510784213098362871-115), granular difficulty sliders (chunk 5766372999940259445-5), the Free Lanes Update adding ship modules including stealth cloaking (chunk 1828894815567715-29), and Update 1.16.236 adding outpost QoL improvements (chunk 1828894815567746-17) are all grounded in the chunks. However, the draft's opening assertion that 'patches haven't touched the core of what you're describing: flight control responsiveness, the depth of ship combat, or the fundamental feel of base and ship building' is not supported by the chunks — the chunks do not contain evidence that these core systems were left untouched, only that certain incremental changes were made. The draft frames the absence of evidence as evidence of absence, which is an over-claim.
